Questions and answers

What is 低視程運用手順?

In this glossary, 低視程運用手順 refers to: Aerodrome ground-movement and approach rules activated whenever reported runway visual range falls below published minima.

How is 低視程運用手順 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "タワー、低視程運用手順が施行中か確認し、タクシーウェイ・アルファのストップバー状況を報告してください。"

Definition

Aerodrome ground-movement and approach rules activated whenever reported runway visual range falls below published minima.

Operational example

Tower, confirm low visibility procedures are in force and advise stop-bar status for Taxiway Alpha.
